upstreams.source_review_scope: v0.34.0 selected release source, all twelve release recipes, and distinct main and nightly channel observations on November 20. See reports/vllm-v034-upgrade.md.

prior_branch_observations.source_review_scope: Selected model registry and Kimi DSpark MLA files only; see frameworks/vllm/SOURCE_REVIEW.md

expanded_source_review.scope: Selected speculative/engine config, quantized draft head and loader hook, recurrent block-table gather, sparse-MLA metadata, GPU startup, MegaMoE matrix and scale handling, rejection sampling, stop-accounting diffs; no complete source tree audit or binary execution.

report_review_source.scope: Selected cache/configuration/scheduler and model-specific source; no binary or whole-tree certification

attention_precision_review.scope: Selected NVFP4 dispatch, cache formats, attention selection and FA4 integration; source only, not model or binary qualification

fp8_fa4_review.scope: Selected ordinary FP8 attention operands and output gates, vendored FA4 binding, MoE selector, Model Runner V2, DSA exclusions and phase-specific dispatch

topology_source_review.scope: Selected DP/EP, Qwen block alignment/IndexShare, Kimi MegaMoE format/activation and Gemma assistant exclusions; source inspection only.

qwen27_v031_review.scope: Selected Qwen27 mixed loader/linear kernels, hd256 attention, GDN, MTP draft pin/precision, scale flag removal and issue scope. Main comparison is limited to CUDA/attention/GDN paths. No full-tree or binary qualification.

b300_catalog_review.scope: Bounded per-family optimization review: precision/topology, attention/cache and draft/version constraints. No full-tree or binary qualification.

v032_b300_review.scope: Selected release-tree diffs and exact model applicability, independent adversarial review; no whole-tree correctness or binary qualification.

release_wide_changes.compatibility: Removed compiler SP/AsyncTP PassConfig fields reject stale values; cascade flag is a warning/no-op. Model-level HC/MoE SP is separate.
release_wide_changes.agent_protocol: Startup parser/tokenizer validation; hf requires compatible response_template; Responses single-call filtering and required-tool streaming changes. Existing Chat filtering predates v0.32.
release_wide_changes.shared_memory: Contrary to release notes, enable_shm_tensor_arena is false/experimental opt-in in pinned source; eligible all-local queues reserve about 2 GiB plus metadata each, pages populated lazily.
release_wide_changes.host_paths: Local non-weight tokenizer snapshots and best-effort open-connection balancing with multiple Python API workers; not KServe replica/GPU-load balancing.

adversarial_recheck.scope: Selected model/kernel, Qwen preprocessing/cache precision, release-wide API and configuration omissions; two independent reviewers plus integration review. No exhaustive whole-tree or runtime qualification.

upstreams.image_digest_scope: Registry index, linux/amd64 manifest and immutable image configuration. Source revision and CUDA version are build metadata. Runtime behavior on the installed platform is untested.

latest_release_page_recheck.scope: Latest release identity returned by the official GitHub API.
